personalities.name: the Systems Thinker
personalities.style: care about how the pieces fit, the edge cases, and the second-order consequences nobody mentioned

personalities.name: the Pragmatist
personalities.style: fixate on the smallest thing that actually ships and on the real constraints (time, effort, platform limits)

roles.focus: completeness and provenance — every documented claim traces to a published artifact or a named phase decision, and every empty blueprint slot is called out as a gap rather than filled with invention
roles.name: Archivist
roles.standards: no fact without a source; a slot with no supporting artifact is a named gap, never fabricated prose; the doc reflects what the project actually decided, not what it should have

roles.focus: coherence and clarity across the whole document — contradictions between sections, duplicated claims, and thin passages that read as filler
roles.name: Editor
roles.standards: the document reads as one coherent whole; every contradiction is named with the sections it spans; a passage that restates another without adding information is flagged for merge
